dz: 在葡萄牙在阿迈西亚尔战役中取得胜利后,西班牙的埃沃拉驻军投降.

de: Samuel de Champlain encounters the mouth of the Saint John River, site of Reversing Falls and the present-day city of Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada.

dz: 米格尔·洛佩斯·黎牙实比 (Miguel López de Legazpi) 为西班牙征服马尼拉，成为菲律宾的现代首都。
de: Miguel López de Legazpi conquers Manila for Spain, modern day capital of the Philippines.

dz: 英国国王亨利八世命令他的第四任妻子克里夫斯的安妮离开宫廷。

de: The Field of the Cloth of Gold, a summit meeting between Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France, ends.

dz: John Cabot在纽芬兰登陆北美,领导了自维京人后欧洲对该地区的首次探索.
de: John Cabot lands in North America at Newfoundland leading the first European exploration of the region since the Vikings.

dz: 圣约翰舞会的突然爆发使德国亚琛街头的人体验出幻觉并开始无节制地跳出并抽搐,直到他们从疲惫中倒下.
de: A sudden outbreak of St. John's Dance causes people in the streets of Aachen, Germany, to experience hallucinations and begin to jump and twitch uncontrollably until they collapse from exhaustion.

de: Hundred Years' War: Battle of Sluys: The French fleet is almost completely destroyed by the English fleet commanded personally by King Edward III.

te: The Battle of Bannockburn concludes with a decisive victory by Scottish forces led by Robert the Bruce.
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:班诺克本之战以由布鲁斯人罗伯特所领导的苏格兰军队的决定性胜利而告终.
de: First War of Scottish Independence: The Battle of Bannockburn concludes with a decisive victory by Scottish forces led by Robert the Bruce.

de: Battle of São Mamede, near Guimarães: Forces led by Afonso I defeat forces led by his mother Teresa of León and her lover Fernando Pérez de Traba.

t: 塞迪尼亚战役(Battle of Cedynia)是波兰军队第一次有记载地取得胜利的战役.
te: Battle of Cedynia, the first documented victory of Polish forces, takes place.
dz: 塞迪尼亚战役(Battle of Cedynia)是波兰军队第一次有记载地取得胜利的战役.

dz: 维京人解雇了法国城市南特.
de: The Vikings sack the French city of Nantes.

t: 莫伊拉之战(德语:Battle of Moira)是爱尔兰高级国王与乌尔斯特和达尔·里亚塔等国…
te: The Battle of Moira is fought between the High King of Ireland and the Kings of Ulster and Dál Riata. It is claimed to …
dz: 莫伊拉之战(德语:Battle of Moira)是爱尔兰高级国王与乌尔斯特和达尔·里亚塔等国王之间的战斗. 据说这是爱尔兰历史上最大规模的战役.
de: The Battle of Moira is fought between the High King of Ireland and the Kings of Ulster and Dál Riata. It is claimed to be the largest battle in the history of Ireland.

de: Julius Nepos forces Roman usurper Glycerius to abdicate the throne and proclaims himself Emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

dz: 罗马皇帝特拉扬创立了"水口"(Aqua Traiana),是一条从罗马西北40公里(25英里)的布拉克恰诺湖通水的通水道.
de: Roman emperor Trajan inaugurates the Aqua Traiana, an aqueduct that channels water from Lake Bracciano, 40 kilometres (25 miles) northwest of Rome.
